title: Rumoured Badlands incident in which two security policemen were found unclothed
summary: Mario Woods tells of Rumoured Badlands incident in which two security policemen were found unclothed, about before 1977 at Badlands, 66th missile area, South Dakota, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there were rumors years before I got there that something happened down toward the Badlands in the 66th area and uh where two security policemen were found uh out of their vehicle

plain: A former guard at a US nuclear missile site named Mario Woods, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, recalls a rumour from before he arrived in South Dakota around 1977. He says the story was that something happened down toward the Badlands, in the area of a missile unit called the 66th, where two Air Force security policemen were found out of their vehicle and unclothed. If true, it would point to some strange event befalling the men guarding nuclear weapons.
